text:
release-bot: [ALERT] Canary wave=3 for service=frontdoor exceeded thresholds: healthcheck_fail_rate=4.2% (>1%), 5xx_rate x2. Dashboards: https://dash.redwood/frontdoor/canary. Runbook: /runbooks/canary-fail.md. Pager: @oncall-alex.

oncall-alex: I'm on it. Looking at graphs now — spike started ~2m after rollout started. Affected regions: us-east, us-west.

eng-sre-jess: Confirming. Trace tail latencies spiked, saw increased KV cache miss rate right before 5xx rise. Canary also uses quantized-model build.

infra-sam: If it's tied to the quantized path we should kill the feature flag 'fastpath-v2' and consider rolling the canary back. I have the kill-switch ready.

oncall-alex: Agreed. I'll toggle the flag first so it's quick to revert. Handoff: I'll keep the pager until stabilization, will hand to infra-sam if noisy after 15m.

release-bot: Action logged: kill-switch toggled by oncall-alex at 1746001215.

oncall-alex: Flipped `fastpath-v2=false` via flags API: `curl -s -X POST https://flags/api/fastpath-v2/disable -H 'Authorization: Bearer ****'` -> 200 OK.

eng-sre-jess: Seeing 5xx rate drop in us-east within ~30s. us-west still showing elevated errors, but trending down.

infra-sam: Starting canary rollback to previous image tag (frontdoor:v1.4.2). Command: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/frontdoor --to-revision=3`.

pm-lina: Any customer impact known? CS team notified?

customer-success-maya: Yep, a handful of customers reporting autocomplete timeouts and slow completions. I attached session IDs to ticket CS-4122. Most requests hit canary nodes.

oncall-alex: Notified CS team and product. Will escalate to engineering if errors persist after rollback.

eng-sre-jess: Quick follow-up: initial hypothesis is quantization path increased tail latency under certain input shapes, exhausting worker threads and causing downstream 502/503. Will create an RCA and a reproducible test case.

infra-sam: Rollback completed across both regions, replica counts bumped temporarily to absorb load. Monitoring for 10m more.

oncall-alex: Marking this thread as mitigated for now — kill-switch + rollback reduced 5xx to baseline. Will keep pager for 30m watch and then close if stable. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Incident created INC-2024-3157 | severity: sev2 | assignees: eng-sre-jess, infra-sam | link: https://inc.redwood/INC-2024-3157

eng-sre-jess: I'll own the follow-up RCA and a patch to the quantized runtime. ETA for initial findings: EOD.

pm-lina: Thx everyone, please include customer impact notes in the incident doc so CS can follow up proactively.

oncall-alex: Acknowledged. Handoff to infra-sam if anything flares while I'm dropping off in 10m.
